autoD: The server syncs by itself, even when the app is closed. Opening the app never starts a sync.
h0: Never, only when I press Sync now
timeD: Your accounts sync at this time every day.
notYet: It has not synced automatically yet.
offD: Sources only sync when you press Sync now.
routineT: Each routine sync reads the last
routineD: Quick and gentle on the bank.
firstImpT: First import of a new source reads
firstImpD: Used once, when you connect a source. The app asks the bank for this much history and keeps whatever the bank still has (banks usually keep 1 to 2 years online). It stops by itself when there is nothing older. You can read further back later with Import history.
f1825: Up to 5 years (whatever the bank has)
logD: Every time the app synced an account: what it asked the bank for, and what came back.
loadFail: The sync log could not be loaded.
